review.posthog_relevance: Adds typed configuration and conditional rendering for shared resource access controls and public sharing settings, including checks for relevant access controls and user permissions.

Also adds checks for public sharing management permissions and conditional rendering of sharing switches and warning banners based on access control availability and relevant access controls.
